svg.title: Heart-rate lag to a step change in demand
svg.desc: The fraction of an instantaneous 60 bpm step in demand that heart rate has completed, over 300 seconds. Runsketch covers 63 per cent of a rise in 50 seconds and 63 per cent of a recovery in 100 seconds, a ratio of two to one. Fake My Stats uses a single pair for every transition, 28 seconds rising and 55 seconds recovering, so both of its curves are faster than ours. A note marks that a step is not a hill: on a real climb, where demand ramps in as the runner slows, the Runsketch rise takes 104 seconds instead. There is no running field reference for the recovery side, so none is drawn.
